component.name: InfiniteNote
component.summary: Local-first OneNote-style notebook with an infinite canvas

description.p: InfiniteNote is an open-source OneNote-style notebook for Linux and Android: organize notes in a Notebook → Section → Page hierarchy and write on an infinite canvas where you can draw and type anywhere. Everything is stored locally (IndexedDB) and the app works offline.

ul.li: Infinite canvas (Excalidraw): draw, type, move and resize anything
Import images, text, Markdown, PDF printouts, Word documents, .excalidraw scenes and OneNote exports (.html and .mht single-file pages with embedded images)
Export PNG, SVG, paginated A4 PDF, .excalidraw scenes and full notebook backups
Cross-page full-text search, page tags with a filter view, quick capture with a pinned Today page
Per-page paper styles: plain, ruled and grid
Soft-delete trash with restore, dark mode, offline-first PWA
File-based sync to a local folder or ZIP with page-granular merge and conflict copies

screenshot.caption: The InfiniteNote workspace: notebook tree on the left, infinite canvas on the right
Mobile layout with the navigation drawer

description.p: Distribution release: the desktop app is packaged for Linux (Tauri shell with deb/rpm/AppImage artifacts attached to GitHub releases, a Flatpak manifest, and an Android Trusted Web Activity scaffold with Digital Asset Links tooling).
File-based sync, phase 1: export notebooks to a sync folder or merge from one (File System Access or ZIP), with page-granular three-way merge, conflict copies and purge tombstones.
Sidebar multi-select with bulk move/delete, an in-app keyboard shortcut cheatsheet, and a sync & collaboration research write-up.
Page tags with a tag filter view, quick capture (Quick note button + Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+N) with a pinned Today daily page, and print-friendly paginated A4 PDF export.
